pages.title: TKDflow — Taekwondo forms library and lessons
pages.description: A free taekwondo forms library with interactive 3D study lessons for WT/Kukkiwon, ITF and ATA patterns.

pages.title: Start here: a beginner’s guide to taekwondo forms — TKDflow
pages.description: New to taekwondo forms? Practical paths for new students, parents and returning learners: how WT/Kukkiwon, ITF and ATA differ, finding your form, reading poses and directions, and using the free lessons.

pages.title: Forms Library — TKDflow
pages.description: Search and filter taekwondo forms by style, belt and difficulty. WT/Kukkiwon poomsae, ITF patterns and ATA Songahm forms.

pages.title: Find a technique in the form lessons — TKDflow
pages.description: Search the blocks, strikes and kicks named in every TKDflow form lesson and open each lesson paused on the exact study pose.

pages.title: Read and print companions for every lesson — TKDflow
pages.description: Every TKDflow form lesson as plain text to read or print: study poses, count labels, turns, kihap and spoken instructions, each linked to the paused lesson.

pages.title: My school’s forms — TKDflow
pages.description: Write down your own school’s belt or level names in your order, add the forms for each and print the list. Saved only in your browser; no account needed.

pages.title: Compare two forms — TKDflow
pages.description: Choose two taekwondo forms and see their style, series, typical belt or level and lesson counts side by side, with links to each lesson and its printable text.

pages.title: Taekwondo words explained — TKDflow
pages.description: Short, plain-English meanings for 12 Korean taekwondo terms from Kukkiwon’s terminology reference, such as Chagi, Makgi and Junbi-jase, with source pages and lesson examples where the forms have them.

pages.title: A short history of taekwondo — TKDflow
pages.description: How modern taekwondo took shape, from the post-war Korean kwans to a national association, Kukkiwon, World Taekwondo, the ITF and the Olympic and Paralympic Games, with each date sourced to the organization that records it.
